# Send a contract link. Get a signature you can prove wasn't changed.

> Send a signing link, collect a typed signature with consent, and keep a certificate anyone can re-verify. A free, open-source, self-hosted alternative to per-envelope e-signature pricing.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
